Create a single self-contained index.html file (inline CSS, no build step, no dependencies, no JavaScript libraries) for an internal operations dashboard.

Heading: "Northwind Logistics" with the subtitle "Q3 2026 Operations Review".

A row of four KPI tiles, each showing the figure and its change against last quarter:
  On-time delivery  94.2%  (+1.8 pts)
  Average transit   3.4 days  (-0.2 days)
  Cost per shipment $18.40  (+$0.60)
  Damage rate       0.7%  (-0.1 pts)

A depot table with one row per depot and four columns -- Depot, Shipments, On-time, Cost/shipment:
  Rotterdam   48,210   96.1%   $16.20
  Hamburg     41,930   95.4%   $17.05

A footer reading "Prepared by the Operations Desk".

Make it look like a dashboard someone would actually put on a wall: aligned numeric columns, a clear type hierarchy, deliberate spacing.
